headline:
Does The Fed Set
My Mortgage Rate?
echo_q: I keep hearing the Fed has cut. So why are mortgage rates going up?
titan_answer: Echo, the Fed hasn't cut this year. It held its rate at 3-3/4 to 4 percent, and it doesn't set mortgage rates.
summary: Mortgage rates have been more closely associated with the 10‑year Treasury than with the Fed's rate. The daily survey you check closed Friday at 7.50 percent, up from the day before. Your own rate depends on your credit, down payment and loan type.
source: Federal Reserve, Oct 28, 2026 · Atlanta Fed, Nov 10, 2025 · Mortgage News Daily, Nov 13, 2026
disclaimer: General information, not a rate quote or a prediction. Your own rate depends on your credit, down payment and loan type; ask your lender.
